slides.fact: means not too much and not too little: _just the right amount_.

slides.title: Not perfect, just right
slides.body:
*Lagom* isn't about the best or the most. It's the amount that feels right, without fuss.

You can use it for food, weather, work, a walk or a cup of coffee.

slides.en: The coffee is just the right temperature now.

caption:
Lagom is the Swedish word for just the right amount: not too much, not too little.

It works for almost anything: food, weather, work, coffee. English needs a whole phrase for it, Swedish needs five letters.

What in your life is lagom?
